ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 0.65 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to 0.35 low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous blobs occupy the central-lateral regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated along the entire superior trailing edge, the central median notch area, and the extreme lateral tips. High-frequency pixel mottling is visible at the boundaries between high and low intensity zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 82 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the superior boundary; pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) are most pronounced on the inner-right lobe edge, appearing as irregular jagged interruptions to the linear flow.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Inferior edges exhibit a convex mathematical curve originating from the peduncle center, transitioning into a tapering concave trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of tan/brown high-contrast pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, unaligned vertical dark linear disruption on the mid-right lobe; several faint, horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical dark linear scar on the right lobe; significant textured protrusions (likely barnacles) at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A pair of vertical high-intensity white streaks located on the low-intensity dark region immediately to the right of the median notch base.
